scope: Seven ordinary English printings with flavor or longer rules, visually checked against full scan-only boxes. Logical poem/attribution paragraphs are preserved; ordinary word wrapping is not a paragraph break. Wall of Brambles punctuation and Wall of Ice attribution/emdash were inspected at native scan resolution. No source correction or renderer change was required. Typography, color, geometry, artist/legal and full-set approval remain separate.
method: Read scan-only name/type/body panels; compare exact Original text. Existing provider text was confirmed rather than treated as evidence of its own correctness.
